title: Other Properties of the Global Object

entries.feature: Temporal namespace: PlainTime construction and conversion
entries.notes: The pinned Test262 Temporal extension is exposed through globalThis.Temporal. PlainTime supports six time fields, constructor coercion and range checks, branded accessors, newTarget prototype selection with exactly one observable prototype read after argument validation, from and compare. Conversion preserves observable field and option access order, validates ISO time strings and IANA annotation components and resolves date-like string ambiguity. ISO date/time and annotation parsing is shared internally for future Temporal types. PlainDateTime and ZonedDateTime interoperation remain unsupported; this does not imply full Temporal support.

entries.feature: Temporal.PlainTime value operations, rounding and formatting
entries.notes: Supports with, equals, add, subtract, round, toString and toJSON, with immutable results and exact nanosecond arithmetic. Time arithmetic validates all duration fields before ignoring date units, wraps at midnight and ignores the optional second arithmetic argument. Rounding supports nine modes, six time units, increment validation and ordered option coercion. toLocaleString uses the base ECMA-262 ISO representation because Intl.DateTimeFormat is not implemented; locale-aware formatting is not claimed. since, until and broader Temporal date/calendar operations remain unsupported.

entries.feature: Temporal.Duration core inputs for PlainTime arithmetic
entries.notes: Supports the ten-field Duration constructor, from, branded field accessors, sign and blank. Duration-like property bags are read and converted in alphabetical order; ISO duration strings preserve fractional time units exactly. Mixed signs, nonintegral fields, calendar-field limits and the normalized 2^53-second bound are validated before time arithmetic. toString and toJSON produce ISO duration strings; toString supports fractional-second precision, second-or-finer smallestUnit and nine signed rounding modes. valueOf rejects numeric coercion with TypeError. General Duration arithmetic and calendar-relative conversion remain unsupported.
Exposes integer typed-array atomic operations and waiter coordination. Full cross-agent memory-model conformance is not yet verified.

entries.feature: JSON intrinsic object is available (JSON.parse, JSON.stringify)
entries.notes: JavaScriptRuntime.JSON exposes both JSON.parse and JSON.stringify. JSON.parse creates ordinary JsObject records, translates parsing errors to JavaScript SyntaxError, and supports post-order, Proxy-aware reviver traversal with observable array lengths, holder this values, deletion, and replacement. JSON.stringify coverage includes function metadata, ordinary property ordering, array replacer filtering/order/deduplication, observable boxed primitive coercion, cyclic-value rejection, well-formed lone-surrogate escaping, and nested Proxy array/object traversal with abrupt-completion propagation. Broader cross-realm behavior remains limited.

entries.feature: Math intrinsic object is available (common Math.* functions and constants)
entries.notes: Implemented by JavaScriptRuntime.Math, backed by System.Math with JS-style argument coercions. Coverage is partial (Supported with Limitations).
